skus.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `skus` (
  `id` varchar(191) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL COMMENT 'SKU ID',
  `product_id` varchar(191) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '所属商品 ID（productId）',
  `label` varchar(255) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT '' COMMENT '规格名（如「智能变速，一档」）',
  `list_price` decimal(18,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0.00' COMMENT '该规格标价（元）',
  `stock` bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '当前可售库存',
  `updated_at` bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '更新时间（毫秒时间戳）',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `ix_skus_idx_sku_product` (`product_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_general_ci COMMENT='商城 SKU 目录（按规格细分的价格与库存）'

activity_prices.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `activity_prices` (
  `product_id` varchar(191) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '商品 ID（主键）',
  `amount` decimal(18,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0.00' COMMENT '活动价（元）',
  `note` text CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci COMMENT '活动说明',
  `updated_at` bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '更新时间（毫秒时间戳）',
  PRIMARY KEY (`product_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_general_ci COMMENT='商品活动价（每个商品一条；未配置则无记录，前端显示「—」）'

columns.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `columns` (
  `id` varchar(191) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '专栏 ID（col_1 等；与激活码种子、商城商品同名，三处必须一致）',
  `title` varchar(255) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT '' COMMENT '专栏标题',
  `summary` varchar(255) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT '' COMMENT '专栏简介',
  `cover_url` text CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci COMMENT '封面图地址',
  `price` decimal(18,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0.00' COMMENT '标价（元）',
  `fulfillment_type` varchar(255) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT 'ACTIVATION_CODE' COMMENT '履约方式：ACTIVATION_CODE=通过激活码发货 等',
  `requires_member` bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '是否要求会员身份才能购买（1=是 / 0=否）',
  `price_presentation` varchar(255) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT 'single' COMMENT '价格展示方式：single=单一口径 / tiered=按档位分档价',
  `checkout_notice` text CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci COMMENT '下单提示语（如「下单后联系门店获取激活码」）',
  `content` text CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci COMMENT '富文本正文（JSON，nodes 结构，见 src/richContent.js）',
  `chapters` text CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci COMMENT '章节数组（JSON：[{id,title,type,content,videoUrl}]）',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_general_ci COMMENT='专栏（可激活内容包；章节与正文以 JSON 保存，结构见 src/columns.js）'

quotes.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `quotes` (
  `id` varchar(191) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '报价 ID（quoteId，提交时凭此校验价格）',
  `scene` text CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '报价场景：checkout=商城下单 / entitlement=开通权益 / upgrade=合伙人升级 / quota_purchase=购买名额 等',
  `user_id` text CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci COMMENT '报价所属用户 ID（未登录报价可为空或 anonymous）',
  `amount` decimal(18,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0.00' COMMENT '报价总金额（元）',
  `breakdown` text CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci COMMENT '费用明细（JSON：goodsAmount 商品额 / discountAmount 优惠额 / listAmount 原价额）',
  `items` text CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci COMMENT '商品明细（JSON：[{key,qty,skuId}]）',
  `meta` text CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci COMMENT '业务上下文（JSON：{productKey,level,memberId,skuId}）',
  `rule_version` bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT '1' COMMENT '计价规则版本号（规则升级后旧报价可识别失效）',
  `issued_at` bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '报价生成时间（毫秒时间戳）',
  `expires_at` bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '报价过期时间（毫秒时间戳）',
  `consumed` bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '是否已消费（1=已被订单占用，防止重复下单）',
  `consumed_at` bigint DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '消费时间（毫秒时间戳）',
  `consumed_ref` text CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci COMMENT '消费方引用（如订单 ID）',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_general_ci COMMENT='报价单（商城结算/权益开通/升级档位共用；默认 10 分钟有效、一次性消费）'
